project.name: Agent Payment Ledger
project.tagline: A payment-aware audit trail for autonomous agents.
project.statusSummary: Public demo, case study, hosted video, NandaHack submission, Splunk HEC proof packet, investigation pack, Microsoft Graph probe evidence, and machine-readable discovery exist. Splunk Devpost, TechEx/lablab, Microsoft Agent Academy, social launch, and judging outcomes remain open or unclaimed.

relationship.positioning: Agent Payment Ledger is a complementary payment and audit receipt layer for x402-style paid API calls, approvals, and exportable evidence.

proofNodes.label: Hosted demo
proofNodes.claim: Agent Payment Ledger has a public hosted demo surface for reviewers.

proofNodes.label: Case study
proofNodes.claim: The project has a public case study that explains the problem, build, evidence, judging angle, and open gates.

proofNodes.label: AgentOps.ai upstream contribution draft
proofNodes.claim: A local-only draft exists for contributing an x402 paid-API telemetry example to AgentOps.ai without claiming affiliation or ownership.

proofNodes.label: Architecture
proofNodes.claim: The repository documents the SDK, ledger, export API, Splunk HEC adapter, Splunk index, and investigation path.

proofNodes.label: Splunk HEC proof
proofNodes.claim: A selected agent payment run was exported to local Splunk Enterprise through HEC as five historical agentops-ledger events.

proofNodes.label: Splunk investigation pack
proofNodes.claim: Reusable SPL searches, prompt templates, and Splunk MCP tool map exist for payment-ledger telemetry investigation.

proofNodes.label: Microsoft Graph probe evidence
proofNodes.claim: A credential-free Microsoft Graph $metadata probe is captured as Agent Payment Ledger evidence.

proofNodes.label: Hosted demo video
proofNodes.claim: A public demo video exists for reviewer and submission surfaces.

proofNodes.label: Outcome tracker
proofNodes.claim: Submission gates, feedback links, and prize/no-prize outcomes are tracked without overclaiming.

proofNodes.label: Feedback issue
proofNodes.claim: The project has a public feedback surface for missing event types, proof questions, and reviewer suggestions.

openBlockers.description: Splunk Agentic Ops Devpost packet is prepared but not submitted.
TechEx/lablab packet and slides exist, but no platform submission proof is claimed.
Microsoft Graph probe evidence exists, but Microsoft Agent Academy submission and outcomes are not claimed.
Broader social launch post has not been posted from the intended account.
No prize, judging result, selected-project status, Splunk AI execution proof, Hosted Models execution proof, or MCP execution proof is claimed.

caveats: Prepared submission packets are not treated as submitted until a public platform URL or explicit confirmation is recorded.
Local Splunk HEC proof demonstrates indexed run_event telemetry; it does not claim Splunk AI Assistant, Hosted Models, or MCP Server execution proof.
The project is not affiliated with AgentOps.ai; any AgentOps.ai contribution is only a local draft until Andy explicitly approves an upstream PR.
The proof page is published on GitHub Pages from the repository's docs source.
